about.title: Avalon Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Avalon is a small place, and when a life ends because someone else was careless, the loss is felt on nearly every block. The city's most recent final crash year, 2025, recorded 11 injury collisions and 17 people hurt, with no traffic deaths reported. Yet wrongful death claims are not limited to the road. A fall on poorly kept property, a medical error, a defective product, or a workplace incident can leave a family asking the same questions. Public records show collision activity clustering along Wrigley Terrace Road, Wrigley Road, Marilla Avenue, and Saint Catherine Way, most often on Saturday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that introduces Avalon families to an independent attorney who handles wrongful death matters in Los Angeles County. Under California law, a spouse, domestic partner, or child usually holds first standing, and the civil claim generally must be filed within two years of the death. The attorney works on contingency, so nothing is owed unless there is a recovery.

items.title: Clarity on who may file
items.desc: California limits standing to a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney you're connected with can confirm where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock is watched
items.desc: A wrongful death action in California generally must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is shorter when a government entity is involved. Getting connected early keeps those deadlines in view.

items.title: Every category of loss considered
items.desc: Recoverable losses can include funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of love, companionship, and guidance. An independent attorney reviews each of these with your family, on contingency.

items.question: Avalon reported no traffic deaths in 2025. Do wrongful death claims still arise here?
items.answer: They can. Public records for 2025 show 11 injury collisions and 17 people hurt in Avalon with no fatalities on the road, but wrongful death claims also stem from property hazards, medical negligence, defective products, and workplace incidents. A small community is not exempt from any of those. If you have lost a family member and believe negligence played a part, it is reasonable to ask an attorney to review the facts.

items.question: Is a wrongful death case the same as the criminal case?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family, separate from any criminal charges the district attorney may pursue. The civil case can proceed whether or not charges are filed, and its purpose is to address the family's losses rather than to punish. The attorney you connect with can explain how the two tracks may interact in your situation.

items.question: What does it cost to use LawProactive and then hire the attorney?
items.answer: LawProactive is free; we simply connect you with an independent wrongful death attorney who serves Avalon and Los Angeles County. That attorney works on a contingency basis, meaning no fee is owed unless there is a recovery. You are under no obligation after the first conversation.
